faqs.a:
(a)
The utilities manager is hereby directed and authorized to enforce all requirements
               and provisions of this article with respect to access to meters, meter pits, and meter
               vaults. Failure of a property owner, agent of property owner, tenant or occupant to
               comply with the requirements of
section 102-62
and/or
102-62.1
shall constitute a violation thereof, and the utilities manager shall be authorized
               to take the following actions in response to any such violation, continuing violation,
               or recurring violation.
(1)
Following the first notice of violation delivered as provided in
section 102-62.2
within a rolling 12-month period, the property owner shall be given a ten calendar
               day grace period to provide the required access to the meter, meter pit, or meter
               vault.
(2)
If the required access is not provided within the initial grace period described in
               subparagraph (1) of this
section 102-62.3
(a), commencing on the 11
th
calendar day after actual or constructive receipt of notice, and continuing thereafter
               for each successive day or part thereof, there shall be assessed a fee of $10.00 added
               to the water bill for the address of the subject property until such time as either
               access is provided, or water service to the subject address is terminated or discontinued.
(3)
Anytime after the twentieth calendar day within a rolling 12-month period that notice
               of failure to provide access is provided, the city may install flow restriction devices,
               and/or suspend water service, and/or relocate, at the property owner's expense, the
               meter to a location where access by the city is available.
(b)
The property owner shall be responsible for all fees and charges imposed or incurred
               as a consequence of enforcement of the provisions of
section 102-62
and
section 102-62.1
as a condition of continued receipt of water service. In the event that water service
               is suspended or restricted as provided in this
section 102-62.3
, restoration of normal water service delivery will not be permitted until access
               is established and all fees and charges are paid. In the event that a water meter
               pit is relocated, the cost of such relocation shall be added to the water bill for
               the address which the water meter serves.
(c)
Any nonpayment or delinquency in payment of any fee or charge assessed pursuant to
               this
section 102-62.3
may constitute a lien upon the property and are assessable as a lien against the
               property as provided in
section 102-41
of
chapter 102
of this Code.
(
Ord. No. 4030, § 1, 10-16-2006
)
